description_en: Queries the configurations of a single origin rule
description_zh: 查询单条回源规则配置
name: GetOriginRule

parameters.help_en: The website ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the configuration. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2866989.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 配置的ConfigId，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2866989.html接口获取ConfigId
parameters.name: config_id

ConfigType.description_en:
The configuration type to query. Valid values:

global: global configurations.
rule: rule configurations
ConfigType.description_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：

global：查询全局配置。
rule：查询规则配置

DnsRecord.description_en: The hostname that overrides the resolved hostname of an incoming request
DnsRecord.description_zh: 改写回源请求的DNS解析记录

Follow302Enable.description_en:
302 follow switch. Valid values:

on
off
Follow302Enable.description_zh:
回源302跟随开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Follow302MaxTries.description_en: The maximum number of 302 follow times. Valid values: 1 to 5

Follow302RetainArgs.description_en:
Retains the original request parameters switch. Valid values:

on
off
Follow302RetainArgs.description_zh:
保留原始请求参数开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Follow302RetainHeader.description_en:
Retain the original request header switch. Valid values:

on
off
Follow302RetainHeader.description_zh:
保留原始请求头开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

OriginHost.description_en: The Host header in origin requests

OriginHttpPort.description_en: The origin port that is accessed when the HTTP protocol is used to back to the origin
OriginHttpPort.description_zh: 使用HTTP协议回源时访问的源站端口

OriginHttpsPort.description_en: The origin port that is accessed when the HTTPS protocol is used to back to the origin
OriginHttpsPort.description_zh: 使用HTTPS协议回源时访问的源站端口

OriginMtls.description_en:
The MTLS switch. Valid values:

on
off
OriginMtls.description_zh:
mtls开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

OriginReadTimeout.description_en: The read timeout period (in seconds) on the origin

OriginScheme.description_en:
The protocol used for origin requests. Valid values:

http: HTTP.
https: HTTPS.
follow: follows the protocol used by the client
OriginScheme.description_zh:
回源请求使用的协议。取值范围：

http：使用HTTP协议回源。
https：使用HTTPS协议回源。
follow：跟随客户端协议回源

OriginVerify.description_en:
The origin certificate verification switch. Valid values:

on
off
OriginVerify.description_zh:
源站证书校验开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Range.description_en:
Use range requests to download an object from the source. Valid values:

on
off
force: enables range origin fetch by force
Range.description_zh:
使用range分片方式回源下载文件。取值范围：

on：开启。
off：关闭。
force：强制

RangeChunkSize.description_en:
The size of the range part. Valid values:

512KB
1MB
2MB
4MB

Rule.description_en:
The content of the rule. A conditional expression is used to match a user request. You do not need to set this parameter when you add global configuration. Use cases:

true: Match all incoming requests.
Set the value to a custom expression, for example, (http.host eq "video.example.com"): Match the specified request
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true。
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

RuleEnable.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. Valid values: You do not need to set this parameter when you add global configuration. Valid values:

on
off
RuleEnable.description_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RuleName.description_en: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when you add global configurations
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数

Sequence.description_en: The rule execution order. The smaller the value, the higher the priority
Sequence.description_zh: 规则执行顺序。数值越小越优先执行

SiteVersion.description_en: The version number of the configurations. You can use this parameter to specify a version of your website to apply the feature settings. By default, version 0 is used
SiteVersion.description_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
